encoder: Frozen pinned WavLM-base-plus; no encoder loading, updates or waveform inference
architecture: Reuse MeanPoolPhoneRatingHead with one pre-pooled vector per target row: acoustic Linear(input,128)+GELU; phone embedding128; concatenated Linear256to128+GELU+Dropout+Linear128to3
features: Either 768 pooled contextual WavLM values, or those values followed by all 13 pinned CTC scalar columns; no age/word/capture metadata inputs
normalization: Each input column uses only the actual regime/fold inner-fit target rows; population SD below 1e-6 becomes1; moments fixed for validation and replay
objective: Ordinary mean five-rater soft-label NLL over target rows; no class weighting, training pseudocounts or probability correction
allAgeRegime: All inner-fit ages; select epoch by all-age inner-validation macro-phone NLL
childOnlyRegime: Fit only ages6–12; select epoch by ages6–12 inner-validation macro-phone NLL; all-age and older metrics descriptive
selection: Within each family/regime/fold choose the lowest declared inner-selection loss across epochs and learning rates; epoch ties retain earlier epoch; exact learning-rate ties prefer0.0003
priorComparator: Per-phone +1/class prior fitted on exactly the same regime/fold target rows; preserve observed support separately; uniform prior for absent fit phones with absence explicitly reported
coverage: Require all14837 eligible rows with exact original identities and finite float32 scalar/pooled matrices; no filtering by rating, CTC support or estimated alignment quality
reporting: Retain each trial's best/last checkpoint, history, probabilities, age-specific proper/ranking/support scores, source/recipe/input digests and same-fit priors; independently replay the saved selected checkpoint
timingLimitation: Forced CTC occupancy plus fixed context is an estimated window, not validated phonetic boundaries;91.1% of this cohort's target occupancy paths contain one frame. Contextual WavLM vectors still contain information from the surrounding utterance
outerEvaluation: No outer prediction/refit entrypoint; this is inner discovery only
